data.gender_notes: Koressa is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Koressa was a name given to the goddess Aphrodite, symbolizing purity and golden hair. This name was also used in the New Testament for a woman who was among the followers of Jesus. The name Koressa carries the meaning “Pure, Golden Haired” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Koressa usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, golden haired and live with faith, good character and purpose.
